items.name: Enterprise architecture category framing discovery
items.description: Validate that the modeled domain should cover EA management, application portfolio management, transformation planning, and architecture governance rather than a narrower diagramming or repository-only product.
questions: Which buying jobs are common across Ardoq, SAP LeanIX, Bizzdesign, OrbusInfinity, and Avolution Abacus?
Where does the competitive landscape extend into adjacent platforms such as strategic portfolio management, IT service management, and risk governance?
Which public metrics are comparable enough to include without changing the reporting scope of the source?
